name: compare/comparison-split
title: Comparison split
title_vi: So sánh hai nửa có thanh chia
desc_vi: Hai khung chung một cảnh: khung "trước" mờ nằm dưới, khung "sau" rực rỡ quét lên từ mép, thanh chia có núm tròn dừng ở vị trí chia và giữ nguyên.
params_vi: split: vị trí chia, % (50) · orientation: horizontal | vertical · labelA, labelB: nhãn hai bên (tự viết hoa) · imageA, imageB: ảnh từng bên (rỗng = cửa sổ khung xương) · duration: độ dài gốc 4 s · bg, fg, surface, border, muted, accent: màu
notes: Layout, colours, sizes, envelope and eases as in the source (panels with a 5 cqw grid on the before side, wireframe window 72 cqw x 64 cqh with toolbar dots, three text lines and a blob, label chips, divider 0.45 cqw with a glow and a round handle of min(5 cqw, 7 cqh); stage 0.32 s power2.out, wipe 1.05 s sine.inOut from 0.25 s, release fade 0.5 s power2.out at duration - 0.5 s; the phases shrink together when the duration is below 1.9 s; horizontal and vertical orientation). cqw / cqh are taken from the target box (the gallery demo uses the same 72 % x 68 % card as the source demo). The wipe was one CSS custom property (--cs-split) driving a clip-path calc and the divider's left; it is now two tweens with the same ease and time: the after panel's clip-path inset (100 % -> 100 - split %) and the divider's x (0 -> split % of the box), so the film holds plain keyframes. The divider handle (::after) is a real child span; no visibility or aria changes, the hf:sfx 'wipe-land-soft' event is dropped (no audio in the kit). The spacing tokens use the values of the source demo's theme (--space-1 / 2 / 3 = 1.2 / 2.4 / 4 cqw) and its colours (bg #07111f, surface #172033, border #40506b, accent #e4e4e7), which are also the source's own fallbacks except the border and the accent. Labels are upper-cased in code (source: text-transform) and are Vietnamese by default (source: Before / After). Extension: imageA / imageB (default empty = the wireframe windows) put a full-bleed picture on a side, covering the window; the label chips stay on top. Font: the film's font instead of Inter. The root takes the radius of its target (border-radius: inherit).
